user.title: Set up mojV
user.description: Choose a live school account or deterministic demo data.

live.title: School account
live.description: Enter the login, alias or e-mail and password used by the school portal. mojV first tries the lightweight connection and automatically uses the local browser helper when full-browser verification is required.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: Create a complete local test dataset without connecting to the school portal.

error.browser_verification_required: The school portal requires a full browser for this account.
error.helper_required: The school portal requires a full browser. Install and start the 'mojV Auth Helper' Home Assistant app from the gekon27/mojv-auth-helper repository, then try again.
error.helper_failed: The local mojV Auth Helper is running, but browser login did not complete. Check the mojV Auth Helper app log.
error.no_students: Login succeeded, but no student was found on this account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the school portal.
error.unknown: Unexpected login error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This mojV account is already configured.

init.title: Notifications
init.description: Choose mojV alerts and optional push notification entities. Home Assistant persistent notifications and mojV events work independently from push delivery.

data.schoolwork_lead_hours: Reminder before schoolwork or test deadline (hours)

data_description.notification_types: Disabling a type prevents new alerts of that kind in all mojV delivery channels.
data_description.notify_targets: Optional notify entities. Leave empty to use persistent notifications and Home Assistant events only.
data_description.lesson_end_minutes: A local one-minute mojV timer checks this threshold without fetching school data again.
data_description.schoolwork_lead_hours: 0 means no advance window before the schoolwork timestamp.
data_description.meeting_lead_hours: 0 means no advance window before the meeting timestamp.
data_description.quiet_hours_enabled: Quiet hours suppress push only. History, persistent notifications and events are still recorded.

options.lesson_changed: Lesson time, room or teacher changed
